with candidate as ( select dispatch_request_id from dispatch_requests where dispatch_request_id = #{dispatchRequestId} and ( status = 'APPROVED' or (status = 'RETRY_WAITING' and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= #{now})) or (status = 'DISPATCHING' and (claim_until is null or claim_until <= #{now})) ) for update skip locked ) update dispatch_requests request set status = 'DISPATCHING', outbox_status = 'CLAIMED', claim_token = md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || request.dispatch_request_id), claim_heartbeat_at = #{now}, row_version = request.row_version + 1, claimed_by = #{workerId}, claim_started_at = #{now}, claim_until = #{claimUntil}, attempt_count = request.attempt_count + 1, command_json = jsonb_set(coalesce(request.command_json, '{}'::jsonb), '{attemptNo}', to_jsonb(request.attempt_count + 1), true), retry_waiting_at = null, next_retry_at = null, updated_at = #{now} from candidate where request.dispatch_request_id = candidate.dispatch_request_id returning request.*

with candidates as ( select dispatch_request_id from dispatch_requests where status = 'APPROVED' or (status = 'RETRY_WAITING' and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= #{now})) or (status = 'DISPATCHING' and (claim_until is null or claim_until <= #{now})) order by updated_at asc nulls first, created_at asc for update skip locked limit #{limit} ) update dispatch_requests request set status = 'DISPATCHING', outbox_status = 'CLAIMED', claim_token = md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || request.dispatch_request_id), claim_heartbeat_at = #{now}, row_version = request.row_version + 1, claimed_by = #{workerId}, claim_started_at = #{now}, claim_until = #{claimUntil}, attempt_count = request.attempt_count + 1, command_json = jsonb_set(coalesce(request.command_json, '{}'::jsonb), '{attemptNo}', to_jsonb(request.attempt_count + 1), true), retry_waiting_at = null, next_retry_at = null, updated_at = #{now} from candidates where request.dispatch_request_id = candidates.dispatch_request_id returning request.*

update dispatch_requests set outbox_status='DISPATCHING', claim_heartbeat_at=#{heartbeatAt}, updated_at=#{heartbeatAt}, row_version=row_version+1 where dispatch_request_id=#{dispatchRequestId} and claimed_by=#{workerId} and claim_until=#{expectedClaimUntil} and outbox_status='CLAIMED'

update dispatch_requests set claim_heartbeat_at=#{heartbeatAt}, claim_until=#{extendedUntil}, updated_at=#{heartbeatAt}, row_version=row_version+1 where dispatch_request_id=#{dispatchRequestId} and claimed_by=#{workerId} and claim_until=#{expectedClaimUntil} and outbox_status in ('CLAIMED','DISPATCHING')
mapper.select: select from dispatch_requests where ((outbox_status in ('CLAIMED','DISPATCHING') and claim_until is not null and claim_until <= #{now}) or recovery_classification = 'ACK_PERSISTENCE_UNCERTAIN') order by coalesce(uncertain_since, claim_until, updated_at) asc limit #{limit}
